node.logic: lbcLockboxCodeType='WEB'. transNote and transReceiptNote come from FormatNote(): ACH -> '<M/dd/yyyy> payment; Transaction ID = <id>; Response = Check Submitted'. REV -> '<M/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss tt> - Web ACH Return - ($<abs amount>) Additional Info: <id>'. CCC -> 'Approval Code=<code>; Transaction ID=<id>'. transReference = masked bank account if a routing number exists, else masked card number.
